messages:
maria: FYI I'm scheduling an overnight 3hr safeguard window for the GPU fleet tonight 02:00-05:00 UTC to run a targeted BMC reset + KV cache warmstart for burst pools. No planned tenant eviction, but we will cordon and drain pods on a handful of nodes in rolling cohorts. :calendar: 
alex: what's the impact on latency for small requests? any chance of higher p95 during warmstart seeding?
raj: short answer: possible spikes if caches are cold. plan is to pre-seed common prefixes and run lightweight batch replay to warm KV. That should cut cold p95 from ~800ms to ~120ms for common models.
june: can we limit the warm-replay to 3 replicas per pool to avoid cross-pool contention? also prefer doing this in az-west1 first as a canary.
maria: yes — starting with az-west1 cohort 1 (10 nodes). If canary looks good we'll proceed to cohort 2. strategy: cordon -> drain low-priority tasks -> run bmc-reset -> run kv-seed job -> uncordon.
alex: will we use reserved capacity to absorb production traffic while nodes are being drained? want to avoid queued requests on the runtime scheduler.
maria: reserving 20% burst capacity in us-west region for the window. ops-bot will create a temporary routing policy to divert new shorter requests to dedicated burst pool.
ops-bot: routing-policy created: policy/id=warmstart-9102468000 -> route short-generations to pool-burst-west (20% capacity).
sam: pointers for the kv-seed job? will it be heavy on PCIe/egress? we should avoid saturating switch egress.
raj: seed job will play back a small corpus (50k tokens per node) with 8 concurrency, limited to 100 Mbps per node throttle. config snippet: ```yaml
job: kv-seed
concurrency: 8
throttle: 100mbps
prefixes: top-2000
models: gptx-small, redwood-opt-1
```
june: please post the rollout checklist in the doc and add a rollback trigger: if p95 > 400ms for >10min, abort and revert routing.
maria: added - abort condition and a manual rollback step. rolling window timeline: canary (10 nodes, 02:00-02:45), pause + verify (02:45-03:00), cohort 1 (03:00-03:45), cohort 2 (03:45-04:30), final sweep (04:30-05:00).
alex: cost/calc ask: how much extra egress / token cost for seeding? rough estimate?
raj: ballpark: 50k tokens/node * 40 nodes total -> 2M tokens ~= $2.5k in inference-hosted units (varies by model). network egress throttle keeps cross-AZ traffic low.
sam: customers with Dedicated capacity — are we notifying them? some run pinned workloads on these nodes.
maria: yes, we already emailed dedicated-owners and posted to status page: short note that maintenance may cause transient routing to alternate pools. support on standby.
june: ops runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-warmstart-ops (please don't share externally).
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: node-list fetched, cordon script validated, kv-seed image sha verified.
alex: I can monitor p95, error-rate and billing delta during the window. will post a short TLDR after.
maria: thanks all. final ask: keep channels quiet unless critical. page if p95 > 500ms or errors increase by >1%. I'll update the maint calendar. :white_check_mark:
